trainer.name: Sylvia
trainer.brief:
Opens by Tagging the biggest threat and Focusing Roaring Moon, then feeds it Momentum all fight. Her Momentum counter IS the clock — at 6 she Seizes The Moment for a guaranteed crit.
No STAB and no ranged option: break the lance's reach and her damage collapses.
trainer.notes:
Level 20 build - Mentor / Herald of Pride (Elemental Connection: DRAGON).
Skill Background (Lv1): Adept Intimidate - Novice Command - Pathetic Medicine Ed./Technology Ed./Occult Ed.
Level-Up ledger on the Level Up tab (14 Features / 17 Edges / 39 Stat Points - the full Lv20 budget).
Milestone choices: Bonus Stats at Lv5, Lv10 and Lv20, all into ATTACK.
DUELIST WAS DROPPED (2026-08-30): Expend Momentum, Effective Methods, Directed Focus, Type Methodology
and Seize The Moment are gone, and Roaring Moon lost the EXPLOIT Ability that Effective Methods gave it.
MENTOR instead - MENTOR SKILLS ARE CHARM AND INTUITION, which is what unlocks the two Lessons wanted:
  - Changing Viewpoints (Intuition): 1 Tutor Point to change a Nature - but only to one that shares the
    RAISED or the LOWERED stat of the current one, so a full swap can take two hops.
  - Empowered Development (Charm): 1 Tutor Point for THREE of Skill Improvement / Advanced Mobility /
    Capability Training, prerequisites waived. Once per Pokemon, ever.
  - Expand Horizons: +3 Tutor Points to each Pokemon (once each).
  - Guidance: every one of her Pokemon has a 7th Move slot.
  - Move Tutor (Daily): 2 TP for any Move on a Pokemon's Tutor list.
  - Lifelong Learning: up to 4 of a Move List's Moves may come from TMs or Tutors.
Skills: Duelist's Focus Expert/Master and the whole Combat ladder were re-spent as Charm Master +
Intuition Novice. Focus stays at Adept so Iron Mind and Work Up keep their prerequisites, and
Intimidate still hits Expert at L6 / Master at L12 for Rouse (L7), Sovereignty (L9) and Call the
Dragon's Rage (L13). Command Adept became Novice (base) - Herald of Pride and Focused Training only
ever needed Novice.
POKEMON: both are now ADAMANT (+2 Attack, -2 Sp.Attack) - every Move either of them knows is Physical,
so the Sp.Attack was dead weight. Roaring Moon Atk 23 -> 25, Iron Mach Atk 20 -> 22.
Each carries Expand Horizons (+3 TP), Empowered Development's three free Edges, and Accuracy Training
on its worst-AC Moves. Roaring Moon has 3 Tutor Points left, Iron Mach 3.
Focused Training (+1 Accuracy, +2 Skill Checks) is a toggle on each Pokemon's Trainings card - flip it
on when the encounter starts; she has no Elite Trainer, so it is ONE Training per Pokemon.
2026-08-30 cleanup: Sovereignty dropped - it bound 2 AP permanently for +2 to Save and Opposed
Checks, neither of which this table rolls, so it was pure AP tax. SIGNATURE MOVE took the slot: Static, and it raises
OUTRAGE from Scene x2 to Scene x3 - one more use of her best attack every fight, with nothing to
remember. Its [+Any] stat tag is pointed at ATTACK, which gives back the +1 Attack that dropping
Sovereignty's [+Attack] tag cost her, so her Attack is unchanged at 26.
Note both her class trees are EXHAUSTED - Herald of Pride is 7 Features and she has 6 (only
Sovereignty is left, and it binds 2 AP for a Standard Action), Mentor is 6 and she has all 6. There
is no other class Feature available to her. Iron Mind dropped (it detects telepathic intrusion; nothing
in the campaign reads minds) - Demoralize moved up to Lv1 and SMOOTH took Lv10: +4 Evasion
against Social Moves and +2 to Saves against Rage and Infatuation.
Weapon of Choice was KEPT but note it is nearly redundant: it only resists Disarm, and Herald
of Pride already lets her resist Disarm with Intimidate. It grants no Weapon Moves - those gate
on Skill Rank, not on the Edge.

trainer.notes:
Level 20 build — Channeler / Shade Caller (Elemental Connection: DARK).
Skill Background (Lv1): Adept Intuition · Novice Charm · Pathetic Athletics/Combat/Medicine Ed.
Level-Up ledger is filled in on the Level Up tab (14 Features / 17 Edges / 39 Stat Points — the full Lv20 budget).
Milestone choices: Bonus Stats at Lv5, Lv10 and Lv20, all into SP.ATTACK.
RULES NOTE: Channeler requires the Mystic Senses Edge and Shade Caller requires Elemental Connection (Dark) — and those two Edges forbid each other by RAW. She carries BOTH, one deliberate GM waiver, so that every other class prerequisite reads as properly paid for. (The old Prism build dodged this by treating Mystic Senses as Elemental Connection (Normal); that equivalence doesn't transfer to a Dark class.)
Twisted Soul → TWISTED POWER: she adds half her Attack to Special damage rolls and half her Sp.Attack to Physical ones — automated on every attack roll, which is why her stat spread is deliberately mixed.
Dark Soul → chose SUPER LUCK (Critical Hits on 18-20, automated). The alternative was Shadow Tag.
World of Darkness → Darkvision Capability, and a Burst 2 zone of Shifting Darkness (−3 Accuracy to anyone without Darkvision attacking from or into it) that also switches on Living Shadow.
Living Shadow: her Dark-Type Moves may originate from any square adjacent to her — or, in darkness, any dark square within her Guile Rank in metres. They don't trigger "when hit by a melee attack" effects.
Type Expertise → DARK (STAB +2 DB on all six of her Moves).
Virtuoso Skills Edge → GUILE. Weapon of Choice → arcane rods.
Her Channeler half (Shared Senses, Battle Synchronization, Power Conduit) needs a Channeled Pokemon — she has none on this sheet yet.
2026-08-30 cleanup: Sneak's Tricks dropped - it taught Astonish, a Damage Base 3 PHYSICAL Ghost Move,
on a Dark specialist with Attack 15 against Sp.Atk 23. EXPERT MANIPULATOR took the slot: +2 on all
Manipulate Maneuvers, and their once-per-Scene-per-foe limit is only spent on a SUCCESS - the exact
mirror of the Expert Trickster she already had for Dirty Tricks.

trainer.notes:
Level 20 build - Ace Trainer / Maelstrom (Elemental Connection: WATER).
Skill Background (Lv1): Adept Athletics - Novice Acrobatics - Pathetic Guile/Occult Ed./Medicine Ed.
Level-Up ledger on the Level Up tab (14 Features / 17 Edges / 39 Stat Points - the full Lv20 budget).
Milestone choices: Bonus Stats at Lv5, Lv10 and Lv20, all into SP.ATTACK.
TYPE ACE WAS DROPPED (2026-08-30): Flood!, Type Refresh and Fishbowl Technique are gone, and both
Pokemon lost the Type Ace Ability grant (Last Chance / Type Strategist) - +2 Tutor Points refunded each.
ACE TRAINER instead, all of it resolved before initiative:
  - Ace Trainer: an hour of training gives each Pokemon a Trained Stat whose default state is +1 CS.
  - Elite Trainer: grants INSPIRED TRAINING (+1 Evasion, +2 Save Checks) ignoring prereqs, and lets
    her apply TWO different [Training] Features per Pokemon - so Agility AND Inspired on both.
  - Dive (Scene x2, Shift Interrupt): dodge a Ranged 1-target attack or step out of a Burst/Blast/
    Cone/Line, at the cost of being Tripped - which her Kip Up Edge undoes as a Swift Action.
  - Special Attack Ace: every one of her Pokemon has +1 base Sp.Atk per 10 Levels - +4 at Lv30
    (Phione 15 -> 19, Tatsugiri 15 -> 19). Static, costs no action, ever.
    NOTE: the sheet does NOT automate the Stat Ace family - no code reads it - so that +4 has to be
    added to each Pokemon's Sp.Atk by hand (or just remembered) until it is automated.
Trainings are NOT pre-applied here: Agile and Inspired are toggles on each Pokemon's Trainings card
(they last until an Extended Rest), so flip both on when the encounter starts. Agile's +4 Initiative
and Inspired's +1 Evasion are auto-applied by the app once toggled.
Maelstrom is untouched and already MAXED - the tree is only 7 slots (class, Call the Current 1-3,
Hydro Jet, Water's Shroud, Oceanic Feeling) and she has every one, so there was nothing to add there.
Skills: Intuition Adept was re-spent as Command Adept (Ace Trainer needs Novice Command; Adept also
opens Critical Moment later). Athletics Virtuoso / Acrobatics Master are unchanged.
Weather: she no longer makes her own rain - Fishbowl Technique is gone, so Drizzle has to come from
a Pokemon. Rain Dance is still on her own Move list (Call the Current Rank 3).
Perseverance was dropped (2026-08-30): cancelling one Injury per Scene is attrition management,
and a rival who appears for one fight never gets to spend attrition. Speed Ace took the slot.
If you ever want ONE button on her, Critical Moment (Elite Trainer + Adept Command, which she has)
triples both Trainings on a Pokemon for a turn - +12 Initiative and +3 Evasion off Agile/Inspired.
2026-08-30 cleanup: Speed Ace dropped (it was a third [Class] row and one Ace is enough) and
Power Boost dropped (+2 Power Capability is lifting, never a fight). Dive and Leader (the Move
After You) took the slots. Swimmer was KEPT - Maelstrom's Gilled beats its hold-breath clause,
but the +2 Swim stacks with Maelstrom's for +4 total, which is worth having in an ocean campaign.

trainer.brief:
Fast and fragile, and every Move he has is one Prismatic Alignment upgrades — spend the 2 AP and Hyper Beam becomes a Burst 2 with Smite. Once per Scene with each of the six.
⚠ His Skills are all Untrained on the sheet, so his Type-Linked Rank reads 2, not 6.

trainer.name: Hiela
trainer.brief:
Opens with Polar Vortex — her whole team fights in Hail from turn one, and Glacial Ice stacks on top of it. Deep Cold goes on the party's best attacker.
Fire undoes two Features at once: it melts Frozen Domain and beats the Hail plan.

trainer.name: Mariposa
trainer.brief:
A grinder. Webs first so nobody leaves, then stack Pheromones on one player until the third one lands a random status.
Shedinja is the fight: Super-Effective damage only, and nothing indirect. Answer it or stall.

trainer.name: Esmeralda
trainer.brief:
A wall that throws rocks — Moon Mountain Stance, then fill the floor with Stealth Rock and eat them for armour. Hurting her team is what feeds Gravel Before Me.
Special Attack 0, no STAB: everything is Physical. Fighting or Ground with reach beats her.

itemDescs.studymanual515playtest:
A Study Manual is always assigned to a single Skill and covers a specific narrow field that can be taken as a Skill Stunt.

Rank 1 - Novice General Education: You gain a Skill Stunt in the associated Skill of the Study Manual covering the narrow field specified by the Study Manual.

Rank 2 - Expert General Education: You gain a general +2 Bonus to the associated Skill. This Bonus does not stack with other bonuses from Books or Equipment to the same Skill.

For learning information about the origins of pokemon.
